summary: The proposed patch introduces a legacy encoding format for session data when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1'. This should help resolve the issue during the transition to Django 3.1.

issues.description: The approach of using legacy encoding format when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1' is somewhat hacky and may introduce fragility. It assumes that the legacy format will always be compatible with the new format, which might not be the case in future versions.
